input.prompt: Using this soldier character only as a colour reference (olive green, dark gunmetal, small cyan accents), draw a single game prop on its own in a realistic, photoreal 3D render style with physically based materials, NOT comic or cel-shaded, no outlines, so it sits naturally on realistic jungle ground and rock textures. A collapsed heap of ancient jungle temple ruin rubble: large broken weathered grey-green stone blocks and tumbled bricks piled high and jagged, about 6 metres long, 3 metres deep and 3.5 metres tall, with sharp uneven tops, a broken column drum and a cracked lintel slab wedged in the pile, moss and a few dangling dead vines. It must look impassable and unclimbable, no flat steps and no path over it. Clean three-quarter front view from slightly above. No character, no person, no plants on the ground around it, nothing else. Whole object visible with margin, transparent background, no shadow, no text.
